recommendations_for_complete_research.required_approach: Direct access to restricted services would require:
steps: 1. Use MCP tools for authenticated access to Zillow, Redfin APIs
2. Contact local MLS boards directly for market reports
3. Access California ATTOM real estate database
4. Consult CoreLogic market reports (often published in real estate trade publications)
5. Review NAR (National Association of Realtors) Bay Area market reports
6. Check local real estate brokerage websites for current listings and market data
